title: Miika Koivisto - AI and Software Projects
content:
Microsoft 365 RAG Assistant

Miika independently designed and developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application for answering Microsoft 365 support questions.

The project demonstrates an end-to-end RAG pipeline rather than hiding the retrieval process behind a high-level framework.

Technologies and concepts used include:

- Python
- Streamlit
- Azure OpenAI
- Azure AI Search
- text embeddings
- vector search
- hybrid retrieval
- metadata
- document ingestion
- document chunking
- retrieval relevance filtering
- grounded LLM prompting
- source attribution
- RAG debugging and retrieved-chunk inspection

Documents are loaded and divided into chunks before embeddings are generated and stored in Azure AI Search.

title: Miika Koivisto - AI and Software Projects
content:
When a user asks a question, the application generates a query embedding and performs hybrid retrieval using both keyword and vector search.

Retrieved chunks are passed to the language model as context. The language model is instructed to answer based only on the retrieved information.

The application can reject questions when sufficiently relevant information cannot be found in the knowledge base.

The project includes retrieval evaluation. Testing showed 91.7% Top-1 retrieval accuracy and 100% Top-2 retrieval accuracy across a 12-question evaluation set.

The user interface was developed with Streamlit and includes source information and a RAG debug view showing the retrieved chunks and relevance scores.

title: Miika Koivisto - AI and Software Projects
content:
The application has been deployed as a web application and the source code is available through Miika's GitHub portfolio.

Work Application Assistant

Miika is developing an AI-powered work application assistant using a multi-context RAG architecture.

The application is designed to allow recruiters to ask questions about Miika's experience, technical skills, projects, the position being applied for and the relationship between his experience and the position.

The system uses:

- Python
- Streamlit
- Azure OpenAI
- Azure AI Search
- vector embeddings
- hybrid retrieval
- metadata filtering
- company-specific retrieval
- document-type-aware retrieval
- company alias normalization

Each application is assigned an internal company identifier.

title: Miika Koivisto - AI and Software Projects
content:
Company-specific documents are tagged with this identifier, allowing Azure AI Search metadata filters to restrict retrieval to information associated with the recruiter's company.

The architecture separates company information, position information and applicant-position matching information.

The application also includes deterministic handling for conversational messages such as greetings, avoiding unnecessary retrieval and language model requests.

Real company and application data is stored separately from the public source code so that private application information is not exposed through the public GitHub repository.

title: Norrin Company Information
content:
Company: Norrin

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Norrin is a Nordic technology company focused on enterprise AI, data,
cloud platforms, software development and system integrations.

Norrin helps organizations move toward AI-enabled business by combining
business expertise, technical expertise and modern technology architectures.

The company provides end-to-end services from strategy and advisory work
to technical design, implementation and ongoing support.

Norrin describes its goal as turning AI and data into measurable business
impact and helping organizations achieve productivity improvements through
enterprise AI.

COMPANY INFORMATION

Norrin reports:
- Approximately 220 employees
- EUR 31 million in revenue
- Approximately 40% annual growth
- Approximately 200 customers

title: Norrin Company Information
content:
Norrin has operated since 2012.

In 2024, Cloud1, Devisioona and Smartbi were combined under the Norrin name.

In 2025, Norrin established Norrin Advisory and expanded into Sweden through
the acquisition of BizOne.

Norrin operates internationally across Finland, Sweden, the United States
and Asia.

The company states that it aims to continue international growth and has
a goal of becoming publicly listed by 2027.

SERVICES AND EXPERTISE

Norrin's areas of expertise include:

- Artificial intelligence
- AI agents
- Enterprise AI governance
- Data platforms
- Analytics
- Software development
- Cloud platforms
- System integrations
- Continuous services
- Consulting

TECHNOLOGIES

Norrin has a strong focus on Microsoft technologies.

title: Norrin Company Information
content:
Technologies and platforms highlighted by the company include:

- Microsoft Azure
- Microsoft Fabric
- Azure Databricks
- Power BI
- Azure API Management
- Azure Integration Services
- Azure AI Foundry

APPROACH TO AI

Norrin focuses on enterprise AI and believes that the value of artificial
intelligence depends on high-quality data and organization-wide adoption.

The company combines AI, data and technology architecture to build
enterprise-level AI solutions.

Norrin describes its approach as covering the complete journey from
guidance and strategy through design and implementation to ongoing support.

VALUES AND CULTURE

Norrin emphasizes people and their expertise.

title: Norrin Company Information
content:
The company believes technology has little value without the people behind
it and aims to build solutions with empathy, respect and an understanding
of everyday needs.

Norrin emphasizes collaboration between colleagues and customers.

The company believes that combining business knowledge with technical
expertise enables effective and measurable results.

Norrin emphasizes honesty, transparency and taking responsibility.

WORKING APPROACH

Norrin values clarity over unnecessary complexity and aims to address
challenges directly.

The company emphasizes asking relevant questions and moving projects
forward decisively.

Norrin aims to stay close to customers, listen to their needs and bring
technical expertise into the customer's actual business environment.

title: Norrin Company Information
content:
The company describes innovation as a collaborative process. It aims to
recommend new and ambitious solutions when justified while relying on
established engineering practices when reliability is important.

Norrin emphasizes building technology that serves real customer needs.

WORKING AT NORRIN

Norrin describes its customers as development-oriented organizations
interested in adopting AI and modern technologies.

Employees work with experienced business and technology professionals
and the company emphasizes both expertise and collaboration.

Norrin operates with a flexible hybrid working model designed to support
both collaboration and work-life balance.

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
Company: Norrin
Position: AI Engineer
Team: Applied AI
Work model: Hybrid

ROLE OVERVIEW

Norrin is looking for an AI Engineer to join its Applied AI team.

The focus and seniority of the role are shaped according to the candidate's
experience, strengths and interests, as well as the requirements of customer
projects.

The AI Engineer designs and builds AI solutions ranging from AI agents and
large language models (LLMs) to more traditional machine learning solutions.

The role combines software development, cloud technologies and AI engineering
to build scalable AI solutions that address business needs.

Employees work alongside experienced specialists and have opportunities to
develop their expertise with their support.

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
AI Engineers also participate in Norrin's AI Guild community, where specialists
develop their expertise and share knowledge.

More experienced candidates may take greater responsibility for solution
architecture, technical direction, mentoring and developing best practices.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The AI Engineer may:

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
- Design and implement end-to-end AI solutions
- Develop agent-based AI solutions
- Develop custom AI agents
- Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions
- Work with traditional machine learning systems
- Build and develop Azure-based AI environments
- Work with Azure AI Foundry
- Use modern software development practices
- Develop software using Python
- Use Git and CI/CD practices
- Deploy machine learning solutions into production
- Monitor and maintain ML solutions using MLOps practices
- Design solutions based on business requirements and technical feasibility
- Integrate AI solutions with APIs
- Integrate AI solutions with databases
- Integrate AI solutions with data platforms

CORE TECHNOLOGIES AND CONCEPTS

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
- Python
- Microsoft Azure
- Azure AI Foundry
- AI agents
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Machine Learning
- Git
- CI/CD
- MLOps
- AIOps
- REST APIs / APIs
- System integrations
- Databases
- SQL

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Norrin is looking for candidates with:

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
- Approximately 3–5+ years of experience with software or data applications
  with an AI/ML focus
- Interest or practical experience with AI agents and LLMs
- Experience in cloud development, particularly Microsoft Azure
- Strong or developing Python skills
- Understanding of modern software development practices such as Git and CI/CD
- Experience with, or motivation to learn, MLOps and/or AIOps
- Interest or experience in deploying ML and AI solutions into production
- Good understanding of APIs and integrations
- Good understanding of databases and SQL
- Structured problem-solving skills
- Ability to consider both business requirements and technical feasibility
- Fluent Finnish and English
- Relevant higher education background in areas such as computer science,
  applied mathematics, engineering or a related field

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
ADDITIONAL ADVANTAGES

Additional beneficial experience includes:

- AI governance and AI management models
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- Terraform
- Docker
- PyTorch
- LangChain
- LlamaIndex
- Deep learning
- LLM evaluation frameworks
- Databricks
- Microsoft Fabric
- Event streams
- Data warehouse solutions
- Systematic software and solution testing
- Consulting environments
- Stakeholder collaboration
- Mentoring or supporting colleagues
- Manufacturing industry experience
- Heavy industry experience
- Energy industry experience

LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT

Norrin emphasizes continuous professional development.

Employees have access to training and certification opportunities.

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
Norrin operates internal guild communities where employees share knowledge
and experience across teams and countries.

As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, Norrin works with modern cloud, data
and AI technologies and supports employees in developing their expertise.

The AI Engineer can develop alongside more experienced specialists and
participate in Norrin's AI Guild.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

Norrin operates internationally with approximately 220 professionals across
Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam and the United States.

The company's customers include Nordic organizations across multiple
industries that are developing their use of data and artificial intelligence.

Norrin uses a hybrid working model.

title: Norrin Position Information
content:
The company describes its culture as based on openness, equality, mutual
respect and psychological safety.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Compensation consists of:

- Competitive base salary
- Performance- and results-based bonus
- Opportunity to participate in an employee fund

Benefits include extensive occupational healthcare and dental care,
insurance, regular massage benefits, and culture and exercise benefits.

content:
Rakettitiede Oy is a Finnish software consultancy founded in 2011.

The company describes itself as employing highly experienced software

Rakettitiede emphasizes demanding and interesting software development

title: Rakettitiede Position Information
content:
Company: Rakettitiede
Position: AI Engineer
Location: Tampere
Work model: Hybrid

ROLE OVERVIEW

Rakettitiede is looking for an AI Engineer who combines strong software
engineering skills with practical AI engineering and consulting capabilities.

The company emphasizes that an AI application is still a software application
and therefore needs to work reliably, securely and scalably in production.

The role focuses on implementing AI functionality as part of actual product
core functionality and user interfaces. AI solutions should provide real value
to users rather than remain demonstrations or prototypes.

The AI Engineer works as part of customer product development teams and helps
customers adopt and utilize new AI technologies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Rakettitiede Position Information
content:
The AI Engineer's responsibilities and important areas include:

- High-quality software development
- Integrating AI components into backend systems
- Integrating AI functionality into user interfaces
- Building production-ready AI applications
- Working with cloud environments
- Advising and supporting customers in the use of AI technologies
- Evaluating implementation approaches
- Developing AI functionality that creates practical user value
- Working as part of customer product development teams
- Communicating with customers and keeping them informed
- Independently developing solutions when necessary

TECHNOLOGIES

Frontend and backend technologies may include:

- React
- Node.js
- Python
- Java
- Go

AI and integration technologies include:

title: Rakettitiede Position Information
content:
- LLM APIs
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- AI development tools
- AI-assisted software development

Cloud, infrastructure and data technologies include:

- AWS
- Microsoft Azure
- Google Cloud Platform
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- Linux
- SQL
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

The exact technologies depend on customer requirements.

EXPERIENCE

Rakettitiede is primarily looking for candidates with at least five years of
broad software development experience and experience integrating artificial
intelligence into production applications.

The company notes that years of experience do not directly determine
competence, but states that sufficiently broad experience is rarely accumulated
in less than five years.

CONSULTING AND COLLABORATION

The AI Engineer is expected to:

title: Rakettitiede Position Information
content:
- Communicate actively with customers
- Keep customers informed
- Advise customers when necessary
- Spar with customers about AI solutions
- Evaluate different technical implementation approaches
- Solve problems based on what is best for the customer
- Work effectively as part of a team
- Be capable of independently building solutions from scratch
- Work professionally in both Finnish and English

WORKING MODEL

The work is performed as part of customer product development teams in
Tampere or the surrounding area.

Remote working opportunities depend on the customer assignment. Currently,
working at the customer's premises approximately two to three days per week
is common.

Consultants can influence which customer assignments they take.

COMPENSATION

title: Rakettitiede Position Information
content:
Rakettitiede states that the average salary is approximately EUR 92,000 per
year.

The company's compensation model pays consultants a gross salary equivalent
to 50 percent of customer billing.
